widgetTool.name: show_product_comparison
widgetTool.description: Renders a side-by-side UI Product Comparison table widget in the chat window comparing Geoff's current Out-of-Contract Fibre 100 (£44.00/mo), Standalone Upgrades (£90.00/mo), and the Cymbal One Converged Home Bundle (£68.00/mo, saving £22.00/mo). Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase. Call this tool immediately after build_tailored_home_bundle(view_type='comparison') when Geoff asks to compare prices or value side-by-side.

features.description: A list of feature rows comparing the options side-by-side.

label.description: The name of the feature being compared in this row (e.g., Monthly Price, Core Broadband Speed, Whole-Home Wi-Fi Hardware, Entertainment, Gaming & Security).

productSpecs.description: A list of specifications, one for each product option being compared, matching the order of productDetails.

text.description: The text describing the feature specification of a specific option.

productDetails.description: A list of objects containing the core details of each option being compared.

imageUris.description: A list of direct URLs to images displaying the option.

price.description: The monthly price of the option.

productId.description: The unique identifier for this option.

rating.description: The average user rating for the option on a scale of 1.0 to 5.0.

subtitle.description: A secondary line of text summarizing the option.

title.description: The primary name of the option as listed.

uri.description: The URL directing users to the full detail page.

title.description: The main headline for the comparison card.

textResponseConfig.textResponseInstruction: Provide a clear, natural spoken response in British English (2 to 3 concise sentences, roughly 30 to 55 words excluding bracketed tags, with 1 to 3 affective prosody tags such as [prosody rate="68%"], [neutral], [short pause], and no exclamation marks) pointing Geoff to the comparison table on screen, highlighting how the £68/mo Cymbal One bundle saves £22/mo compared to £90/mo standalone while upgrading his £44/mo out-of-contract Fibre 100 plan, and asking if he would like to see the mesh coverage map or add the bundle to his basket.
